```{=html}
<script>
(() => {
  const home = document.getElementById("portfolio-home");
  const photo = home?.querySelector(".profile-photo");
  if (!photo) return;

  const entrances = ["rise", "slide", "zoom", "tilt"];
  let lastEntrance = "";
  let homeVisible = false;
  let lastPlayed = -Infinity;

  function playEntrance() {
    if (window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) {
      return;
    }

    if (performance.now() - lastPlayed < 1000) return;

    const choices = entrances.filter(name => name !== lastEntrance);
    lastEntrance = choices[Math.floor(Math.random() * choices.length)];
    lastPlayed = performance.now();

    photo.classList.remove("portrait-enter");
    photo.dataset.entrance = lastEntrance;
    void photo.offsetWidth;
    photo.classList.add("portrait-enter");
  }

  const observer = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
    const visible = entries[0].isIntersecting;

    if (visible && !homeVisible) {
      playEntrance();
    }

    homeVisible = visible;
  }, {
    rootMargin: "-100px 0px 0px 0px",
    threshold: 0
  });

  observer.observe(home);

  document.addEventListener("click", event => {
    if (!(event.target instanceof Element)) return;

    const link = event.target.closest("a[href]");
    if (!link) return;

    const destination = new URL(link.href, location.href);
    const samePage =
      destination.origin === location.origin &&
      destination.pathname === location.pathname;

    if (samePage &&
        destination.hash === "#portfolio-home" &&
        homeVisible) {
      playEntrance();
    }
  });

  window.addEventListener("pageshow", event => {
    if (event.persisted) {
      playEntrance();
    }
  });
})();
</script>
```
